english.title: Develop / produce / stockpile / acquire / retain biological agent or toxin
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[developed]_
(B)_[produced]_
(C)_[stockpiled]_
(D)_[acquired]_
(E)_[retained]_

a biological agent or toxin of a type and in a quantity that had no justification for prophylactic, protective or other peaceful purpose, namely **(..SPECIFY QUANTITY AND TYPE OF AGENT OR TOXIN..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1)(a) and (3) of the Biological Weapons Act 1974.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Prosecution of this offence requires the consent of the Attorney General, see section 2 Biological Weapons Act 1974.
(ii) See section 1A for territorial application and section 1B for prosecution procedure.
